artifacts.summary: All six plan phases completed (Phase 6 with reasoned exclusions for two pre-existing, unrelated gate failures and the known literature zotero hang); guard-destructive-git.sh now refuses a foreign git stash pop/apply with exit 2 while an owned pop and git-snapshot.sh's rollback flow keep working.

completion_data.completion_summary: Added a session-scoped stash-provenance ledger and a new tree-state-blind hazard-class-3 predicate to guard-destructive-git.sh that refuses git stash pop/apply of a foreign (not-this-session-created) entry with exit 2, closing the 2026-10-09 'push saved nothing, then pop drops a foreign entry' incident. All 4 ACCEPTANCE criteria verified via 107 passing fixture cases plus a live end-to-end probe against the redeployed hook; git-snapshot.sh's rollback flow (both modes) and an owned pop continue to pass.

memory_candidates.content: When a new PreToolUse/PostToolUse hook writes per-session state files under tmp/ (e.g. agent-system/extensions/core/tmp/ in source-store mode, .claude/tmp/ in deployed mode), ALWAYS add a matching runtime-artifact exemption to lua/neotex/plugins/ai/shared/extensions/verify.lua's is_runtime_artifact() (mirroring the tmp/noop-bash-count-*/tmp/noop-bash-shapes-* precedent) and a matching assertion to test-deploy-orphans.sh -- otherwise gate 13 (whole-tree orphan detection) will flag the file as a stable, unavoidable orphan on every session's first qualifying Bash call, not merely a flaky one. Discovered while adding guard-destructive-git.sh's stash-provenance ledger.

Any fixture test that drives a real hook/script as a subprocess and that hook/script writes session-scoped state under a tmp/ directory with no caller-supplied override env var MUST export that override (e.g. STASH_PROVENANCE_STATE_DIR, following NOOP_BASH_STATE_DIR's precedent) to a scratch mktemp -d location for the whole test section -- otherwise every suite run pollutes the source store's own (un-gitignored) tmp/ directory with real debris files. Easy to miss when adding fixtures to an existing suite that already isolates OTHER env vars (e.g. PUSH_GRANT_DIR) but not this new one.
